typedArtifactContract.equalityRule: Every tuple member must equal the owner-resolved stored value byte-for-byte after canonical UUID and lowercase sha256 normalization.
typedArtifactContract.artifactRevisionRule: artifact_revision is an owner-local monotonic revision allocated when PER prepares the artifact. It is independent from the later Platform configuration version; only the finalized binding row contains both values and no equality between them is inferred.
typedArtifactContract.immutabilityRule: A configurationId and version binds exactly one artifact public ID and digest. Corrections create a new Platform version and a new PER artifact version; update-in-place is forbidden.

migrationDecision.reason: The executed V1-V18 Performance schema has no PER-004 typed payload source of record, while Platform V325 explicitly retains only lifecycle metadata and owner references.

exactDelta.prf_per_artifact_versions: Replace only the closed artifact-type and owner check constraints so the three PER-004 artifact types are accepted with owner_aggregate_type PERFORMANCE_CONFIGURATION_VERSION; preserve all existing compensation values and constraints.
exactDelta.prf_per004_artifact_preparations: One CAS-governed preparation row per tenant, configurationId and Platform create idempotency key. It binds the owner-local artifact revision, artifact public ID, schema, payload reference/digest, scope digest and one owner preparation receipt. Reuse with the same exact key and request digest returns the same fact; a different payload fails closed. Allowed binding states are PREPARED, FINALIZED and QUARANTINED; these are handshake states, not configuration lifecycle states. QUARANTINED is permitted only after an authoritative Platform lookup proves that no version or create receipt exists for the key; timeout, unavailability or an unknown result must remain PREPARED and retryable.
exactDelta.prf_per004_configuration_version_binding: Exactly one immutable finalized row per tenant, configurationId and Platform version, and exactly one finalized binding per artifact public ID. It stores the exact binding tuple and Platform create receipt reference.
exactDelta.prf_per004_owner_evidence_receipts: Append-only VALIDATION or SIMULATION receipt rows. A simulation row must reference the exact validation receipt and carries the impact digest; both are uniquely bound to the finalized tuple.
exactDelta.publishInbox: NOT_IN_V19. IAQ reads the trusted Platform lifecycle query port. A later event projection requires its own successor and dedicated inbox because the workforce inbox allowlist cannot be reused.

trustedOwnerHandshake.create: The browser invokes only the existing Platform create-version action and supplies the closed typed owner payload, never an authoritative reference or digest. This discriminated owner-payload envelope is accepted only when domain is PER and schemaKey is one of the three sealed PER-004 schema keys; every wrong domain, schema or envelope combination fails closed. The existing non-PER payload-reference request contract is preserved byte-for-byte. Platform treats the PER payload as transit-only opaque JSON, enforces a 262144-byte UTF-8 limit, never persists, logs, audits or echoes it, verifies its own command authorization and forwards it with trusted tenant, configuration, schema, scope and idempotency facts to the PER owner prepare port. PER canonicalizes, validates, encrypts and stores an immutable owner-local artifact plus a PREPARED receipt, then returns its server-derived reference and digest. Platform reloads the configuration, proves no working version exists, verifies the owner attestation, inserts the DRAFT version and owner preparation receipt under one local unique/CAS guard, and returns its idempotent create receipt. A committed Platform outbox fact drives an idempotent PER finalize callback that writes the immutable configuration-version binding. Validation is blocked until Platform receives and stores the exact finalize acknowledgement. A failed or ambiguous callback is retried by the same idempotency key; a preparation may be quarantined only after an authoritative Platform lookup proves that no version or create receipt exists.
trustedOwnerHandshake.validate: Platform resolves the PER owner through a server-side trusted port. PER reloads the exact tuple under RLS, decrypts and canonical-verifies the payload, performs typed domain validation and returns an immutable owner receipt bound to the tuple. Platform verifies all returned binding values before recording VALIDATED.
trustedOwnerHandshake.simulate: Platform supplies only its trusted exact tuple plus an opaque owner-resolvable sample scope reference and digest. PER resolves the scope server-side, performs domain simulation and returns an immutable owner receipt and impact digest bound to the validation receipt and tuple. Platform verifies them before recording SIMULATED.
trustedOwnerHandshake.failureMode: Owner unavailable, unresolved reference, tenant mismatch, schema mismatch, version mismatch, payload digest mismatch, scope mismatch, stale evidence or receipt mismatch fails closed and performs no lifecycle transition.
trustedOwnerHandshake.receiptPersistence: Platform stores the owner preparation, validation and simulation receipt IDs and binding evidence separately from its own central command receipts.

crossSliceDispositions.owner: BASE-TFR-PER-005 and its cycle aggregate own cycle commands and PerformanceCyclePublished. PER-004 does not implement, emit, expose, recount or claim them.

per014TemplateBoundary.decision: PER-014 owns the mutable template authoring aggregate and cycle-designer workflow. PER-004 owns only the immutable centrally governed configuration payload version and its Platform binding.
per014TemplateBoundary.reviewFormAndScaleRule: A PERFORMANCE_REVIEW_FORM or PERFORMANCE_RATING_SCALE preparation must carry an exact trusted PER-014 template-version provenance and digest. PER-004 exposes no independent browser form/scale create or update command. Before PER-014 integration, those artifact kinds may be EMPTY in IAQ-020 and may be exercised only with synthetic owner fixtures in tests.
per014TemplateBoundary.performancePolicyRule: PERFORMANCE_POLICY is directly authored through the PER-004 owner command and follows the create handshake above.
per014TemplateBoundary.noDuplicateSor: The PER-014 authoring aggregate is the source of authoring truth; the PER-004 artifact is the immutable lifecycle payload snapshot. It cannot be edited, reverse-synchronized or used as a second mutable template aggregate.

IAQ-020.reason: The operational forms-and-scales query is read-only for PER-004; cycle mutation belongs to another aggregate and slice.

IAQ-056.reason: PER-004 exposes the exact central configuration lifecycle only; cycle publication and undeclared lifecycle extensions are outside this slice.

acceptanceCriteria: PER004-AC01 Platform remains the only lifecycle metadata and central receipt source of record.
PER004-AC02 Performance is the only complete typed payload source of record for form, scale and policy artifacts.
PER004-AC03 V19 extends the V17 typed-artifact foundation and adds the exact preparation, finalized-binding and owner-evidence tables under FORCE RLS.

PER004-AC04 Platform create prepares one owner artifact, admits at most one working version under a database guard, finalizes one exact binding, and validation resolves the actual owner payload while rejecting every tuple or digest mismatch.
PER004-AC05 Simulation resolves the exact prior validation receipt and produces a bound immutable impact digest.
PER004-AC06 Submit is mandatory between simulation and approval; maker-checker and step-up remain enforced.
PER004-AC07 IAQ-020 returns contract-closed field-policy projections and no PER-004 actions.

PER004-AC08 IAQ-056 returns only the six declared Platform actions, at most one transition per item by lifecycle state, including publish only for APPROVED_DUE or SCHEDULED_DUE under the sealed clock rules.
PER004-AC09 Every action is exact-target-bound and never derives authority or identifiers from browser input or masked data.
PER004-AC10 Owner and Platform outages, stale evidence and partial failures render explicit fail-closed states with no local lifecycle fallback.
PER004-AC11 Frontend implements accessible loading, empty, complete, partial, unavailable, forbidden, retry and step-up states at 1440, 1280, 390 and 320 widths plus 200 percent zoom.
PER004-AC12 Feature default is OFF, enrollment is empty, route and menu mounting is withheld, and no production provider or business-completion claim is made.
